selection: The 50 judgments listed in core_50.json, a subset of echr-post-v1.0-candidate-20261108. One target per judgment. no_violation stratum: up to 30 judgments by SHA-256 rank of seed|item_id, taking the lowest-ranked no_violation target. violation stratum: 70 targets allocated across decision months by largest remainder in proportion to eligible judgments, ranked within month by the same hash; lowest-ranked violation target per judgment. Substitutes are the next ranked judgment in the same stratum and month. Core 50 = lowest-ranked 15 no_violation + 35 violation.

target_contract.unit: one judgment, one respondent State, one provision, one sub-conclusion
